==Notes==
*This is an effect during the [[Consulate Docks]] mission.
*Health is still affected by [[rune]]s and [[armor bonus]]es.
*Armor is set to the profession's max [[armor rating]] (i.e. 60 for [[Monk]]s, [[Necromancer]]s, [[Ritualist]]s, [[Mesmer]]s, and [[Elementalist]]s, 70 for [[Ranger]]s, [[Dervish]]es, and [[Assassin]]s, and 80 for [[Warrior]]s and [[Paragon]]s).
